setting.regions.description: Region effects edited in the control panel. Up to 8 areas can independently control blur, opacity, tint, brightness and saturation, with adjustable feathered transitions. Coordinates follow the original image or video; later areas take priority where they overlap.
extension.description: Choose an image or muted video background for your code editor, with adjustable frosted glass and automatic resizing.
command.restore: Turn Off Background and Restore Editor
setting.updateMode.description: Get updates from the extension’s configured public GitHub repository. Checks about 30 seconds after startup, then every 6 hours. The window never reloads automatically.
setting.blur.description: Default background blur radius in pixels. Code stays sharp. Region effects can override this value; changes apply live after initial setup.
setting.opacity.description: Background opacity. Higher values make the background more visible. Suggested range: 0.2–0.5.
setting.tintOpacity.description: Opacity of the frosted overlay, using the current theme’s color. Higher values make code easier to read.
setting.saturation.description: Background saturation: 1 preserves the original colors; 0 uses grayscale.
setting.brightness.description: Background brightness: 1 preserves the original brightness.
setting.fit.description: Images and videos automatically follow the editor’s dimensions.
setting.playbackRate.description: Video playback speed. Videos always play muted and loop.
setting.pauseWhenUnfocused.description: Pause video when the window loses focus. Video always pauses while the window is hidden.
setting.respectReducedMotion.description: Keep video as a still frame when the system’s reduced motion preference is enabled.
setting.updateMode.automatic: Automatically check, download and install new GitHub releases, then prompt to reload.
setting.updateMode.notify: Automatically check and notify you when an update is available; you choose when to install it.
setting.updateMode.off: Stop background checks. You can still check for updates manually.
setting.fit.cover: Fill the editor while preserving proportions; edges may be cropped (recommended).
setting.fit.contain: Show the entire image while preserving proportions; empty space uses the theme’s background color.
setting.fit.fill: Fit the entire image into the visible code area without cropping; proportions may change.
